fit_reason: Makes lasers, transceivers, modulators, ROADMs and other optical components and modules for data communications and telecom fiber networks. Lasers are needed by every optical design, and optical is central to its business.

Makes fiber-optic networking products including optical modules, laser components, transceivers and subassemblies, sold to internet data center operators. Lasers and transceivers for data center links are central to its business.

Provides optical packaging and manufacturing services and makes transceivers, tunable lasers, modulators and active optical cables for data centers and computing clusters, including Ethernet and InfiniBand connectivity. Optical is central to its business.

Makes data center interconnect chips: PAM and coherent DSPs, laser drivers, silicon photonics, co-packaged optics, linear pluggable optics chipsets, active electrical cable DSPs, retimers, UALink scale-up switches and Ethernet switches. It covers optical, copper and scale-up networking, and networking is central to its business.

Makes high-speed connectivity chips, active electrical cables and SerDes chiplets built on its SerDes and DSP technology for both optical and electrical Ethernet. Connectivity is its whole business and it covers copper and optical links.

Makes coherent optical transport, packet-optical and reconfigurable switching platforms plus Waveserver data center interconnect systems and network automation software. Optical transport between sites is central to its business, which fits scale across.

Makes semiconductors for wired infrastructure, including enterprise and data center networking, alongside storage, wireless and software businesses. Data center networking is a major part of its business, but the description gives no product detail.

Makes semiconductor connectivity products for data, network and memory links in cloud computing and AI infrastructure. Connectivity inside AI systems is its whole business, but the description gives no product detail.

Makes cloud networking products: Ethernet switching and routing hardware plus network operating software, sold mainly to large internet companies. Data center Ethernet is central to its business and underpins scale out and scale across.

Makes lasers, laser systems and optical components. Lasers are needed by every optical design, but the description describes mainly industrial and scientific uses, so the data center share of the business is unclear.

Makes indium phosphide and gallium arsenide substrates used for data center lasers and VCSELs, silicon photonics, photonic integrated circuits and fiber optic lasers. It supplies material for the laser layer, but data center optics is only part of a wider substrate business.

Makes optical fibers, cables, fiber optic connectors, cable assemblies and closures for telecom and business networks. Fiber carries the links beyond the rack, but optical communications is one of several businesses alongside displays, glass and life sciences.
Sells GPUs and also Mellanox networking and interconnect products inside its Compute & Networking segment for AI data centers. Networking is a meaningful part of the business, but GPUs are the core.

Makes analog semiconductors across RF to lightwave, including components for optical networking and data centers. Optical and data center products are one of several end markets alongside telecom, defense and industrial.

Makes signal integrity chips, including optical data communication ICs for data centers, passive optical networks and optical transceivers. Optical data communication is a meaningful part of a broader analog and mixed-signal portfolio.

Sells network infrastructure including coherent optical transponders, WDM, ROADMs, data center interconnect and IP routing to hyperscalers, among mobile and fixed network businesses. Optical networking is a meaningful part of a large telecom equipment business.

Makes electrical and fiber optic connectors, backplane interconnect systems and cable assemblies for data communication, among many other markets. Copper interconnect inside the rack is a meaningful part of its business.

Provides electronics manufacturing and makes data communication equipment such as routers, switches and data center interconnects, with hyperscalers among its customers. Networking hardware is a meaningful part of a broader contract manufacturing business.
Makes communications chips for optical transceivers, broadband and fiber modems, and wireline routers. Optical transceiver chips are one product line within a broad communications chip portfolio.

Makes IP networking equipment including data center and campus switching and routing, plus security and collaboration software. Data center switching is a meaningful part of a business centered on enterprise networking.

Makes network test, monitoring and assurance instruments and software used to build and run network infrastructure, plus optical security products. It is exposed to network buildouts but supplies test tools rather than the networking links themselves.

Makes connectors, cable assemblies and fiber optics for many markets, with data centers and AI named among them. Data center connectivity is a part of a mostly transportation and industrial connector business.

Makes printed circuit boards, including boards for data center computing and switching networks. Boards for data center networking are one part of a business spread across aerospace, automotive and other markets.

Provides electronics manufacturing and makes interconnect systems, backplanes, cable assemblies and optics products for cloud computing customers, among other markets. Data center hardware is a meaningful part of a diversified manufacturing business.

Provides electronics manufacturing and design services to networking, data storage, cloud infrastructure and 5G customers, among many industries. Networking and cloud infrastructure customers are a meaningful part of a broad manufacturing business.

Supplies fiber optic and copper cabling and connectivity for data centers and telecom, plus access and aggregation switches. Data center cabling is a meaningful part of a business that also covers cable TV and enterprise wireless.

Makes copper and fiber cabling, connectivity, racks and enclosures for data centers, plus industrial Ethernet switches and cables. Data center cabling is a meaningful part of a business that also serves industrial and building markets.

Makes wired and wireless network equipment and management software, including data center switches and routers. Data center switching is only one part of a business focused on enterprise campus networks.

Provides network services including optical wavelength networks, unlit fiber leasing, Ethernet and data center services. Its fiber network could carry links between data centers, but it is a service provider, and much of the business is enterprise and consumer services.

Makes electronic test and measurement instruments, including network test platforms for data centers and optical analysis equipment such as laser sources and modulation analyzers. It is exposed to networking buildouts through test demand, but supplies tools rather than links.

Makes fiber, diode and hybrid lasers and fiber amplifiers, plus optical transceiver and transponder modules for data center networking. Lasers are needed by every optical design, but the description is dominated by industrial materials processing.
Makes power, circuit protection and interconnect components for data infrastructure and other industries. The description is too thin to show how central networking is to the business.
